page.overview:
Who is Corkus?

Corkus was a member of the original Band of the Falcon who previously led a small band of thieves. He was killed during the Eclipse as a sacrifice.

Corkus usually appears very cynical and world-weary, but hints of his idealism show through. He is quick to acknowledge each step toward a better position that the Band of the Falcon has earned through their hard work, and he greatly enjoys their elevation to peerage. Judeau mentions that Corkus once tried to achieve something for himself but failed, leading to him joining the Band of the Falcon. When preparing to kill Guts to seize his reward for killing Bazuso, Corkus laments that Bazuso was killed by Guts, as he wanted to slay Bazuso himself and gain fame. He is fiercely loyal to Griffith, claiming that Guts' attacks on Griffith are part of his strategy and that Griffith's loss was "a fluke". Corkus believes Griffith is "special" and without equal.

Corkus is depicted as antagonistic toward Guts, often without provocation, though he becomes worried for Guts when he breaks his sword in battle against Boscogn. He is joyful when Guts is able to fight back against Wyald. Corkus fully expresses his disdain for Guts when the latter decides to leave the band, denouncing Guts' supposedly self-centered nature. He admits to aiming arrows at Guts' back in several battles and threatens to kill him if they meet again on the battlefield. However, Corkus shows a rare moment of support when Guts feels guilty about leaving Griffith, reassuring Guts that Griffith's imprisonment was not his fault. He also accepts Guts' help in rescuing Griffith, despite resenting Guts for not being around when the band needed him most.

At some point, Corkus was the leader of a small gang of thieves consisting of ten members. One day, Corkus and his gang confronted the nascent Band of the Falcon and were easily defeated, after which Corkus became a member of the band. Some time after his enlistment, Corkus and the rest of the band came across a young girl named Casca; despite his disapproval of having a kid join them, she was accepted into the band.
